origin.description: Floyd's algorithm. A missing or positive infinite edge is unreachable, and an unreachable length comes back missing.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Square edge costs. None is a missing edge.

origin.details: middle_points is 1-based. Zero means the path has no intermediate vertex. The diagonal length is zero.
origin.value: length and middle_points, both n by n.
origin.example:
cost <- matrix(c(0, 1, 4, NA, 0, 2, 3, NA, 0), 3, byrow = TRUE)
sp <- allShortestPaths(cost)
cat(sp$length, "\n")
